description: Spoorlengte-types op hoofdsporen is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Kilometers hoofdsporen per type, korte spoorstaven of langgerekte sporen (LGS). Dankzij de technische vooruitgang van de fabricatie en de ervaring opgedaan bij het aanleggen van sporen, werd de lengte van de spoorstaven groter en groter. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Infrastructuur. Its keywords are Sporen. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
